paper_main_selection_rule: Use the first six values of the already frozen seed list for every category, yielding 5 categories x 6 seeds = 30. The rule is numeric-order based and does not replace failed cases.

categories.selection_reason: The official semantic registry assigns KitchenCabinetFactory to Storage, and it is the only cabinet factory in the frozen public 20-factory release.

The official semantic registry assigns TableDiningFactory to Table. It is the generic dining-table generator; TableCocktailFactory is a narrower cocktail-table alternative, so exactly one factory is frozen to avoid category duplication.
BeverageFridgeFactory is the sole refrigerator/fridge factory in the frozen public 20-factory release.
DishwasherFactory is the sole dishwasher factory in the frozen public 20-factory release.
OvenFactory is the sole oven factory in the frozen public 20-factory release.

denominator_policy: The paper main retains six requested seeds per category and the supplement retains all seeds 0-35. Terminal timeout or missing-asset cases remain failures in the corresponding requested denominator.

hierarchy_mapping.semantic_depth: maximum named-link root-to-leaf path length; root counts as 1
hierarchy_mapping.named_group: named link with children and no visual geometry

cross_seed_scope: Topology stability only. Raw named-edge and name-free canonical-shape signatures are reported; neither is semantic correctness.

independent_hierarchy_gold.required_for_edge_f1: An independently authored, asset-aligned parent-child edge set plus a frozen predicted-node to gold-node matching policy.
independent_hierarchy_gold.required_for_exact_match: A complete independently authored gold tree for every scored asset and a frozen canonicalization policy.
independent_hierarchy_gold.required_for_semantic_nesting: Independent semantic parent assignments or blinded human adjudications for every scored child node.
rejected_as_gold: the Infinite Mobility factory source code used to generate the asset
raw or canonical topology signatures derived from the generated output
tree validity, root count, or hierarchy depth inferred from the generated output

notes: This is the paper-facing common-category subset of the already frozen public-factory 36-seed run.
The balanced 30-asset main view uses seeds 0-5 for every category; the full 180-case view remains the seed-distribution supplement.
No asset is regenerated or replaced for this subset.
Parent-child Edge F1, hierarchy exact match against gold, and semantic nesting accuracy remain N/A because no independent hierarchy gold is available.
